text: Over the last 30 days, all visitor reviews mentioned the food quality and wait times, indicating these are key aspects of the experience. While the average rating was a perfect 5.0 and no critical feedback was given, the repeated focus on food and wait times suggests these areas are important to visitors. Service was noted in two reviews, and atmosphere was mentioned once. Overall, there were no negative comments, but attention to maintaining or improving food and wait times could be beneficial.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. Food quality and portion sizes were frequently criticized, with complaints about overpriced items and meals that did not meet expectations. While the library itself received positive remarks, the café’s pricing, menu choices, and service logistics were areas needing attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited, overpriced, and the quality inconsistent, with several noting poor preparation and small portions. Service delays and long wait times were also mentioned, including times when the kitchen was backed up and orders could not be taken. While some visitors appreciated aspects of the food, the overall experience with the cafe’s offerings and pricing needs attention. Other aspects of the visit, such as atmosphere and menu variety, received fewer comments.
